## If the record has to be updated

Run `python scripts/make_zenodo.py`, then in Zenodo choose **New version** on
the existing record and upload the fresh files; the concept DOI keeps pointing
at the newest version while this version DOI stays citable.

**ORCID.** The record is linked to 0009-0006-9624-385X through the ORCID login
used to create it.
